A '''Detainment [[Droid/Legends|droid]]''' was a type of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] used extensively in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|detention centers]] to secure and guard prisoners. They moved using [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] and were fitted with [[Binders/Legends|binders]] on the end of each of their four limbs, which could be used to restrain their captives.
